# Resolver fixtures

Metadata records trimmed from the real API answers on 2026-10-17 (no
abstracts, no reference lists). Synthetic parts, for tests only:

- `openalex-seeger-2010.json`: the arXiv location `0903.0001v2` is made up;
  the paper has no arXiv copy.
- `crossref-search-made-up.json`: Crossref's answer to a search for a made-up
  reference ("Quantum gravitational lensing of tea cosies", Smorgasbord 2019).
  Crossref returns its nearest records; none of them is the reference.
